body:
`Dict` subclasses' child nodes are now reflect the expected behavior that they're instances of that subclass instead of `Dict`s. Without this change, daughter nodes of subclass instances raise Attribute or other errors. 

Added tests appropriate for these changes. 100% of tests passed.

See https://github.com/mewwts/addict/issues/101
